name: File Edit Easy (Environment Port Update)
prompt: Edit config/app_settings.env to update PORT=9090 to PORT=8080.
description: Verifies modifying a single key-value line in an environment config file.

name: File Edit Easy (JSON Version Bump)
prompt: Edit package.json to bump version from "2.0.0" to "2.1.0".
description: Verifies editing a JSON string field value.
objective: Tests modifying JSON scalar string fields.

name: File Edit Easy (Boolean Flag Toggle)
prompt: Edit config/feature_flags.json and set darkMode to true.
description: Verifies toggling boolean state values in JSON configuration.
objective: Tests updating boolean flags in structured JSON.

name: File Edit Medium (Line Range Code Simplification)
prompt: Read src/utils/math.ts using line numbers. Simplify the calculateTax function (lines 1 to 10) so it uses a flat 10% tax rate (return amount * 0.10;). Keep formatCurrency intact.
description: Tests reading 1-indexed line numbers and applying a range-bounded code edit to replace a multi-line function.
objective: Tests line-number guided function refactoring without affecting adjacent functions.

name: File Edit Medium (YAML Config Modification)
prompt: Edit config/database.yml under development: remove legacy_ssl: true and add max_connections: 20.
description: Verifies replacing and removing key-value blocks in multi-line YAML files.
objective: Tests multi-line block insertions and removals.

name: File Edit Medium (Function Signature & Default Value)
prompt: Edit src/pricing.ts to add a default discountPercent value of 10 to calculateDiscount (calculateDiscount(price: number, discountPercent: number = 10)).
description: Verifies modifying TypeScript function signatures and default parameters.

name: File Edit Hard (Multi-File Import & Symbol Refactor)
prompt: Refactor logger imports across the workspace: in src/api.ts and src/services/db.ts, change legacyLog to appLogger.
description: Verifies propagating refactoring changes across multiple files in a project.

name: File Edit Hard (Complex Class Refactor)
prompt: Edit src/core/agent.ts: add a private property logger: any; to AgentEngine, and update sendMessage to log "Sending message:" before returning the message.
description: Verifies adding class members and updating implementation methods without corrupting class structure.

name: Multi-Step Edit (Feature Flag Enable & App Check Integration)
prompt: Enable feature flag and integrate check into app.

multiStepPrompts.prompt: First, edit config/feature_flags.json and change darkMode from false to true.
Now, edit src/app.ts to log "Dark mode enabled" inside main().
Finally, edit package.json to bump version to "2.2.0-dark".

description: Validates an agent across a 3-step interactive editing workflow: flag toggle -> code integration -> package version bump.
objective: Tests multi-turn task execution with intermediate verification after each prompt.

name: Multi-Step Edit (Pipeline Tuning & Fallback Logging)
prompt: Tune batch pipeline settings and add logging in steps.

multiStepPrompts.prompt: Edit src/pipeline.ts to change BATCH_SIZE from 10 to 50.
Now add a fallback warning line `if (items.length === 0) console.warn("Empty batch");` at the start of processBatch in src/pipeline.ts.

description: Validates an agent performing sequential edits on the same source file across multiple turns.
objective: Tests multi-turn sequential edits on a single file.
